description: This file contains extension methods for the IServiceCollection interface, enabling registration of existing service implementations within dependency injection setup in Orleans.Serialization.Utilities.Internal namespace.

classes.name: InternalServiceCollectionExtensions
classes.description: A static class providing extension methods for IServiceCollection to facilitate dependency registration.

methods.name: AddFromExisting
methods.description: Registers an existing implementation of a service as a provider for a specified service type, based on previous registration.

methods.name: AddFromExisting (overload)
methods.description: Performs the registration of an existing implementation type as a service, by locating its previous registration and creating a new one for the specified service type.
